sloka: कस्मै चित् याचमानाय ददौ राघव नंदनः ।ततः प्रीतेषु विधिवत् द्विजेषु द्विज वत्सलः ॥१-१४-५५॥
transliteration: kasmai cit yācamānāya dadau rāghava naṁdanaḥ ।tataḥ prīteṣu vidhivat dvijeṣu dvija vatsalaḥ ॥1-14-55॥

translations.english: Sacrifice destroys sins. It leads to heaven. It is incapable of being done by other monarchs. King Dasaratha was very much pleased after performing this great sacrifice.
